doc: High-detail layered character rig (96x128 cells). Built by art/tools/r3d (own cel-shaded 3D renderer, no pxl). One PNG per slot item, move and direction: frames run left to right, parts/expressions are stacked top to bottom in the order of the slot's `rows`. Ground anchor of every cell is (48,124). Layers share the frame index and the same skeleton/camera, so any combination lines up.

body.note: bare chibi base: skin, head, hands, legs, feet and a plain neutral under-layer. No hair, no clothing, no face features.

face.note: eyes, brows, mouth and blush only, projected on the head surface so they turn and foreshorten with the head. The row is the expression (switching it needs no loading). `blink` is for a short periodic blink. Not generated for n, ne, nw (the face is hidden).

zOrder.note: bottom to top. `@expression` is the wearer's current expression row. Hair, outfit, hat and tail layers are added to these lists as they land.

hair.note: 13 parts (back 4, far side 2, top 2, near side 2, front 1, locks 2) so a hat can hide exactly the parts that would clip through it

hat.note: back sits behind hair and body, front covers what must stay under it; carries a `hides` list of hair parts

tail.note: attached at the hip, sways while walking
